2.title:
Properties located
  at 725 and 751 Fanshawe Park Road West (H-8050)

content.string:
Recommendation:  That, on the
  recommendation of the Senior Planner of Development Services, based on the
  application of Decade Group relating to the property located at 725 & 751
  Fanshawe Park Road West, the attached proposed by-law BE INTRODUCED
  at the Municipal Council meeting to be held on June 26, 2012, to amend Zoning
  By-law No. Z.-1, (in conformity with the Official Plan), to change the zoning
  of the subject lands FROM a Holding Neighbourhood Shopping Area
  (h-h-54-h-89-NSA3) Zone TO a Neighbourhood Shopping Area (NSA3) Zone,
  to remove the holding provisions.
